title: German Hamburgers (Frikadellen)
description: This frikadellen recipe with ground pork and beef, onion, parsley, egg, and hot paprika makes a batch of delicious pan-fried German meat patties.
ingredients: salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Soak kaiser roll in a medium bowl of water for 10 minutes. Drain and squeeze out excess water; crumble into a large bowl.
Add ground meats, onion, parsley, egg, paprika, salt, and black pepper to crumbled roll; mix until well blended. Shape mixture into large flattened meatballs.

Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Fry meatballs in the hot skillet until browned and no longer pink in the center, about 5 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center of a patty should read at least 160 degrees F (70 degrees C).

video.description: In this video, learn how to make the original hamburger, pan-fried and served like a flattened meatball. Make it a meal, and serve the burgers with steamed string beans and a fresh tossed salad. You can also serve them on a Kaiser roll with lettuce, tomato, pickled cucumbers, finely sliced deep fried onions and curry ketchup. Remember to keep your finished burgers warm in the oven as you continue to cook the rest in a skillet.
